**Finding: missing (insurance) — redline validated and submitted.**

- No insurance provision exists anywhere in the Agreement (document-wide search for "insurance" returned nothing).
- Coverage is warranted: Garman installs the Software at Authorized Locations and converts Sparkling's data (§4), and delivers on-site training (§5), so both premises and data exposure are present.
- Fix: new General Matters subsection (j) inserted after p0147 requiring CGL USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M for processing of Sparkling's data, statutory workers' compensation, and certificates on request, maintained through the term plus one year. I referenced "Sparkling's data" rather than "Customer Data" since the latter is not a defined term here. The comment flags the E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M fallback.
